description: This file defines the IconPicker React component, which provides a user interface for selecting icons or emojis, featuring tabs for icon selection, emoji input, and reset functionality. It manages internal state for current selection type and emoji input, and renders either an icon grid or dropdown for icon selection, along with emoji input handling and platform-specific instructions.

classes.name: IconPicker
classes.description: React component providing icon and emoji selection UI with tabs, emoji input handling, and configurable icon display options.

classes.name: TabButton
classes.description: Functional subcomponent for rendering tab selection buttons with active styling.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Switches between 'icon', 'emoji', and 'reset' tabs; resets icon selection when 'reset' is chosen.

methods.name: handleIconChange
methods.description: Handles icon selection changes, propagating selected icon value upward.

methods.name: handleEmojiChange
methods.description: Handles emoji input changes, updates input value, and triggers selection when emoji length is 1.
